## 主张 Claim

共享 Process 中，空方法及参考装置经实际失败、取得、安装和使用形成。直接复用 P99 的操作，每一后继位置的失配都修改方法、取得双参考、安装并成功使用；成功兑现的生产回返支付更替和下一修订。统一控制器中存在实际无限 Run，精确衔接形成历史；每轮累计消耗及取得不清零。冻结、断供、储备消耗和旧区分退役保留实际失败与损失。 / In the shared Process, actual failure, acquisition, installation and use form a reference apparatus from empty retention. Directly reusing P99 operations, mismatch at every successor revises the method and yields newly acquired, installed and successfully used references. Earned production pays succession and the next revision. An actual infinite Run obeys one controller and connects exactly to the formation trace, with cumulative ledgers. Frozen methods, cut return, reserve expenditure and retired distinctions retain failures and losses.
